$description: Trace Practice source colors with authored semantic roles; DTCG 2025.10 color representation.

reading-ground.$description: background; Rendered source page 1 white reading ground. Mint is a secondary/reversed source color, not the whole page background.

reading-ink.$description: text; Exact value observed in native source/foundations or CSS. This semantic role is a deliberate editorial identity decision after reviewing native usage; alternate cover and reading grounds are distinguished.

accent.$description: accent; Exact value observed in native source/foundations or CSS. This semantic role is a deliberate editorial identity decision after reviewing native usage; alternate cover and reading grounds are distinguished.

supporting-field.$description: surface; Exact value observed in native source/foundations or CSS. This semantic role is a deliberate editorial identity decision after reviewing native usage; alternate cover and reading grounds are distinguished.

table-row.$description: surface; Native reference.docx word/document.xml active shading/border value #F1F5F7; source visual and native-design-style-audit corroboration.

table-rule.$description: rule; Native reference.docx word/document.xml active shading/border value #C7D4DA; source visual and native-design-style-audit corroboration.

mint-support.$description: support; Native direct run color #EAF3F1; retain for supporting/reversed areas rather than assuming page fill.
